_csp_comment: media-src is REQUIRED for dashcam playback: connect-src only covers
fetch/XHR/WebSocket, not
media-src the element falls back to default-src and the video is
blocked outright with no visible error.
http://localhost:3000 was likewise missing from img-src, which would
have blocked Jetson snapshots served from /api/snapshots the moment
security.csp: default-src 'self' tauri: asset:; connect-src http://localhost:3000 ws://localhost:3000; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' http://localhost:3000 data: blob:; media-src 'self' http://localhost:3000 blob:; script-src 'self'
